Dr. Kabir has officially joined **Texas A&M University** as an Assistant Professor in the Department of Engineering Technology & Industrial Distribution (ETID). This marks the formal launch of the **Laboratory for Advancing Sustainable Energy Resilience (LASER)** at TAMU.

## About the New Home

ETID at Texas A&M brings together expertise in engineering, industrial distribution, and applied research — a natural fit for the group's mission to develop advanced analytics for future energy systems. The group will also engage with the broader Texas A&M Energy Institute community.

## Looking Ahead

The group is now actively recruiting PhD and MS students interested in energy system optimization, weather-informed analytics, power outage modeling, and related topics. See the [Join Us](../../join/index.qmd) page for details.
